confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Newcastle NSW pricing, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and drink anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies with July school holidays, events and weekday versus weekend demand. The FX observation is the 15 October 2026 RBA figure as reported in a search summary of the RBA exchange rates overview page; I did not confirm it against the F11 daily table, and a 16 October third-party figure was not used because it is not an RBA source.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on regional coastal New South Wales cities with similar visitor profiles and price levels, such as Wollongong and the Central Coast, adjusted for Newcastle's position below Sydney pricing. Accommodation assumes July is winter, with some uplift for school-holiday weeks.
